findings.title: Native client auth strategy passed under pre-0.31 `strategy` key
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The native path still sends `strategy` after the rename, and only a mocked test covers it, so a plausible unverified risk follows from the pin; confirm the field or pass authStrategy.

findings.title: Customers with base64 clientKey fail at construction after upgrade
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The exact 0.31.0 pin brings in hex-only clientKey decoding, which the changeset and the skill doc both describe, so base64-key deployments break on upgrade; a release-note or pre-check fix is proposed.

findings.title: wasm encryptConfig now relies on FFI cast_as normalisation
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: The native entry already passed unnormalised config to the Rust normaliser at base, so WASM now matches native rather than diverging, and the author reports checking 0.31 WASM parsing; the claimed cross-binding mismatch has no support.

findings.title: DynamoDB callers branching on error.code see a different code
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The handleError change maps foreign codes to DYNAMODB_ENCRYPTION_ERROR exactly as cited; this behaviour change comes from the PR.
